evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts

observations.why: Directive issued in the present to erase specific named artifacts (fleet, contracts); the desired erasure is not yet actual, marking irrealis.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes

observations.why: Present-tense directive targeting a category of knowledge (routes in general) rather than a specific artifact; the removal is commanded but not yet actual.
